facts.summary: FDA issued complete response over third-party manufacturing concerns; no efficacy or safety deficiencies · Filed · DefenCath in catheter-related bloodstream infection prevention in hemodialysis · filed for approval
facts.indication: Prevention of catheter-related bloodstream infections in chronic hemodialysis patients

evidence.summary: FDA) cannot approve the New Drug Application (NDA) for DefenCath™ (taurolidine/heparin catheter lock solution) in its present form. FDA noted concerns at the third-party manufacturing facility
evidence.safety: did not identify any deficiencies related to the data submitted on the efficacy or safety of DefenCath from LOCK-IT-100
evidence.program_discontinued: CorMedix intends to work closely with the FDA and the manufacturing facility to support the completion of the review of the NDA.
